results.title: Citi Raises Seagate and Western Digital Targets as AI Data Demand Supercharges Storage Pricing
results.summary: Citi raised STX to $595 and WDC to $405 on AI-driven HDD demand supercycle. Both benefiting from hyperscaler buildout.

results.title: Cantor Fitzgerald Raises Western Digital Price Target to $500
results.summary: Cantor Fitzgerald raised WDC PT to $500, noting HDD pricing squeeze is just getting started. WDC holds ~52% nearline market share vs STX ~42%.

results.title: Seagate (STX) vs. Western Digital (WDC): Morgan Stanley Picks Top IT Hardware Stock
results.summary: Morgan Stanley picked STX over WDC as #1 IT hardware pick, citing stronger margins. WDC trades at 19.95x forward P/E vs STX at 23.12x.

results.title: Move Over, Western Digital! Why Seagate Is the New Top Stock Pick
results.summary: Analysis favoring Seagate over WDC due to HAMR Mozaic technology lead; Mozaic 3+ already in volume production and Mozaic 4+ in development vs WDC HAMR still targeting H1 2026 for initial qualification.

results.title: The AI Storage Supercycle: A Deep Dive into the New Western Digital (WDC)
results.summary: WDC also benefiting from AI storage supercycle; completed SanDisk spinoff in early 2026, now pure-play HDD. Both STX and WDC are seeing nearline capacity constraints due to hyperscaler demand.
